service_name: Water Supply Service Requests (Right to Services Act)
sub_service: New water connection, water bill, no-dues certificate, reconnection
problem_type: New water connection request, billing query, reconnection of water line
department: Nagpur Municipal Corporation -- Public Health Engineering Department
description: NMC's own Right to Services (RTS) Act page publishes real, numeric day-limits for water-related service requests. This page does not include dedicated entries for routine road-repair or streetlight-complaint resolution -- only water supply and a few other services (food-business NOC, tree-cutting permission) are covered.
procedure: Submit request through NMC's citizen services portal or ward office under the Maharashtra Right to Public Services framework.
sla: New water connection: 15 days. Water bill: 3 days. No dues certificate: 3 days. Reconnection of the water line: 15 days.
